transcript_previews.content:
On Morpho there are two flavors for supplying USDC, and the right pick depends on how hands-on you want to be:

**Curated MetaMorpho vault (simplest)** — you deposit USDC into an ERC-4626 vault and a curator allocates across many Morpho Blue markets. Popular USDC vaults on mainnet:
- Steakhouse USDC — conservative, blue-chip collateral (wstETH, WBTC, cbBTC)
- Gauntlet USDC Prime — risk-managed, sl...your USDC and slightly higher gross APY (no vault fee).

A couple of things worth noting before we pick:
- Alice (0xf39F…2266) is a test account. Real funds need your own wallet connected.
- 100 USDC is small enough that gas will dominate any yield difference between options on mainnet.

Which direction do you want — a curated vault (and which curator) or a direct market (and which collateral)?
